venture_under_test.name: Glean
venture_under_test.description: Glean is an enterprise AI-powered search and knowledge platform that connects to 100+ workplace tools (Slack, Jira, Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GitHub, Salesforce) to surface unified semantic search results, AI-generated answers, and personalized work assistants. Target customers: enterprises with 500-50,000 employees facing knowledge fragmentation across many SaaS apps. Pricing: $30-$60 per seat per month, enterprise-only annual contracts. Target buyer: Chief Information Officer (CIO), Head of Workplace IT, Chief Knowledge Officer, or VP of Operations. Competes with Microsoft Copilot, Coveo, Lucidworks, Mendel.ai, and ChatGPT Enterprise. Differentiation: native connectors to 100+ apps (vs Microsoft Copilot's Microsoft-stack-only), permissions-aware search (respects every source app's ACLs natively), and personalized AI assistants tuned per role from organizational graph.
